sloka: आपतन्तीं शिलां दृष्ट्वा गदामुद्यम्य सम्भ्रमात् ।रथादाप्लुत्य वेगेन वसुधायां व्यतिष्ठत ।। ६.५२.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: āpatantīṁ śilāṁ dṛṣṭvā gadāmudyamya sambhramāt ।rathādāplutya vegena vasudhāyāṁ vyatiṣṭhata ।। 6.52.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Beholding the rock descending upon him, Dhumraksha rushed instantly on the ground from the chariot and stood.
